prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1321; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's okay. You already have it in the claim file.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Pasadena, Texas. I had just pulled into a space near the main entrance.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I was backing out of the space to leave. I checked my mirrors and didn't see anything, so I started reversing slowly.

Q: What happened next?

A: A vehicle coming down the aisle hit the rear quarter panel of my car. It wasn't going very fast, but it was enough to jolt me forward and then back against the seat.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?

A: No. I think the driver was looking for a spot and didn't notice me until it was too late.

Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?

A: I felt a stiffness in my neck right away, but I didn't think much of it. By that evening it was sore and I had a headache.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next day. They diagnosed a neck strain and gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and do some stretching.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Some. Turning my head to the left is the hardest. I've missed a few days of work because of it, and I'm still going to physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I'd like this handled as quickly as possible, since the medical bills are piling up.

Q: Understood. Thank you for your time.
